name: Disneyland The Tropical Hideaway Sweet Banana & Cream Cheese Lumpia
whyItWorks: Crispy fried spring roll wrapper stuffed with warm ripe banana, jackfruit, and sweet cream cheese, dusted in cinnamon sugar. Bananas are gentle on the gut.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Sweet Lumpia warm for an afternoon treat; enjoy while sitting along the Jungle Cruise river.
watchOuts: Fried wrapper carries moderate oil; eat slowly
